name: game-ready-assets
description: Production rules for turning a model into a game-ready asset: triangle, material, and bone budgets per platform with LOD chains; clean topology, normals, and UVs; texel density and texture sizes; PBR texture naming, channel packing, and compression; and export settings for Unity, Unreal Engine, Godot, and Blender. Skills only: nothing to install or connect.

interface.tagline: Budgets, topology, UVs, textures, LODs and export for any engine.
prompts: Is this character mesh ready for a Quest game? Check its triangle budget, UVs, and textures and tell me what to fix.
